blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY – The bullet-riddled remains of a village councilor and a church pastor were found dumped at a mountainous section of Barangay Capissayan Norte in Gattaran, Cagayan last weekend. Responders recovered the bodies of Johnny Agarpao, a 52-year-old San Miguel village councilor and 30-year-old pastor Jeferson De Leon of Baggao town. A farmer, who was tending to his grazing carabao, saw one of the bodies. When disaster responders and police arrived at the area, they also discovered the other body about 35-meter away from the first discovered remains Further investigation is ongoing....
